properties.name: Sharing a design through git is retired: dec:multi-writer-architecture (2026-07-25, "many writers keep the repo file and merge on pull — no hosted service") is superseded by the design-and-export rules, on Anthony's word 2026-09-27
properties.rationale:
Anthony, 2026-09-27: "I'd like to accept the 6 rules as official. Let's reverse the 07-25 rule - let's retire sharing design through git." It follows a day of export defects that all sat on the seam between git-carried sharing and server-held designs (fact:a-moved-design-cannot-be-watched-and-its-frozen-export-reads-as-live-2026-09-27, fact:an-agent-opened-in-a-moved-designs-folder-is-served-the-frozen-store-2026-09-27).

WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, deliberately: it retires no requirement or capability by itself. The seven nodes the 07-25 decision governed or supported lose their governing decision, not their need. cap:cluster-claims, req:concurrent-planning, req:session-memory-in-graph, req:content-reaches-every-seat, dec:idea-need-to-know-compartments and dec:idea-package-versus-shared-server each need re-reading under rule 2: several people still plan at once and still need not to collide, now on one shared design instead of across merged copies.

THE EXPORT MACHINERY IS RETIRED IN PURPOSE AND KEPT IN SERVICE, until reflow2 and flo2 themselves move to a server. That covers req:stale-seat-knows, dec:export-once-per-pr, req:the-saved-design-merges-correctly-under-gits-ordinary-merge, the file lineage in dec:export-hash-chain, req:the-server-keeps-the-working-tree-export-current, and the CI gate reading the committed export. Their purpose (people sharing one design through git) is gone. But reflow2's and flo2's own CI and PR flow still run on them, and the replacement (CI checking code against a design on a server: open question (b), req:results-from-the-code-flow-back-into-a-design-that-lives-elsewhere) is unbuilt. Retire each when its replacement lands, not before, or those two repos lose their design check.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Sharing a design through git is retired for all designs. The design-and-export rules (dec:idea-one-blueprint-the-store-is-the-design-and-an-export-is-a-perishable-photocopy) are accepted on Anthony's word, and they supersede dec:multi-writer-architecture (07-25: many writers keep the repo file and merge on pull, no hosted service) and dec:repo-file-embedded (07-18: exports are the durable, diffable record; not a service). A design is its server's store, people share it by sharing that server, and an export is a copy at one moment reflow2 never tracks.
